stages.title: Identity and legal documents
capture: privately match full VIN on title, body and manufacturer labels; seller authority and liens
verify original US 2011 Turbo4/Premium sedan, FWD and automatic; verify factory options rather than trim badge
photograph engine and transmission identifiers, case tags and prior swap invoices privately
stages.stop_when: Title/VIN tampering or unlawful transaction; confirmed excluded configuration is outside this project
stages.hold_when: missing title/ownership proof, mismatched VIN, uncertain engine/transmission identity

stages.title: Storage history and safe access
capture: last ran/moved dates, reason parked, exact seller fault description and invoices
battery swelling/leakage, rodent wiring, fuel odor/leaks, fluids and signs of flood/fire
confirm competent person approves any lifting/cranking; no unsupported structure access
stages.stop_when: unsafe fuel leak, fire/flood damage to safety systems or structure, unsafe support points
stages.hold_when: history or underside cannot be inspected; suspected seizure/hydrolock/oil starvation means no cranking until assessed

stages.title: Structure, accident damage and chassis
capture: subframes AND body attachment metal, sills, floor, suspension/steering anchors, brake/fuel line corrosion
crash repairs, buckling, missing bolts, seam separation and alignment evidence
distinguish flaking coating from confirmed section loss; qualified structural inspection
stages.stop_when: confirmed unsafe load-bearing corrosion/accident damage or required structural restoration beyond objective
stages.hold_when: hidden mounts, substantial scaling or accident repairs not evaluated

stages.title: Cold engine health before start
capture: overnight ambient/ECT/IAT and whether seller pre-warmed engine
qualified cold compression and leakdown per cylinder with exact conditions/units when indicated
crank authorization, plugs/fluid inspection and diagnostic sequence; preserve raw readings
stages.stop_when: confirmed internal head/valve, bearing, piston or timing damage requiring work outside accepted no-rebuild goal
stages.hold_when: warm demonstration only, unmeasured suspicious cold no-start, timing noise or unknown pressure; codes alone do not identify cause

stages.title: Lubrication, timing, turbo and cooling
capture: oil condition/filter debris, coolant contamination, leak locations and documented service
qualified mechanical oil pressure at factory temperature/RPM and timing inspection if warranted
pump/thermostat/fan/pressure tests and turbo feed/return/charge-air condition only after safe running approval
stages.stop_when: confirmed destructive low oil pressure, metal/bearing damage, serious overheat/internal damage or unsafe active leak
stages.hold_when: unexplained rattle/pressure warning, untested cooling/fan system, seller only says turbo or sensor

stages.title: Fuel and emissions
capture: fuel age, contamination and leaks; vehicle emission label
separate low-pressure pump/control from DI rail/pump actual-versus-commanded values
use approved pressure-relief and fuel tools; retain codes/freeze frames, no casual pressurized-line opening
stages.stop_when: unsafe leak; confirmed damage beyond project objective
stages.hold_when: unresolved no-start, missing catalytic hardware or unknown legal replacement; do not purchase pump from codes alone

stages.title: AF40-II and axles
capture: case tag, controller ID, fluid history, leak and coolant-contamination evidence
scan codes/freeze frames before clearing; authorized fluid check at factory 70-80 C only when safe
qualified cold/hot engagement and road behavior only after structure/brakes/tires legal-roadworthiness assessment; no stall test
confirm installed shaft/strut and mount variants
stages.stop_when: confirmed internal slipping/contamination/damage requiring rebuild or unpriced complete transmission replacement outside objective
stages.hold_when: nonrunner cannot demonstrate loaded transmission; unproven gearbox claim, case/controller mismatch

stages.title: Module communication, keys and power
capture: test each available key and authorization; complete module scan including ECM/TCM/BCM/ABS/SDM/keyless/cluster/HVAC where fitted
save VIN/calibration/part IDs, network faults and battery voltage before resets
prove power/grounds/network before condemning modules; written current programming/key support quote
stages.stop_when: confirmed irreparable safety/security/network damage outside objective
stages.hold_when: missing keys, unavailable modules, incomplete scan, no current security/programming repair route

stages.title: Brakes, restraints, HVAC and unique equipment
capture: brake codes/hydraulic integrity/parking brake operation; ABS bleed and learning requirements
SRS warning/self-test, airbags/belts/PPS labels and crash history; current VIN campaign documentation
defrost/fan/compressor and every unique US lamp, glass/HUD, cluster, radio and body control
photograph missing connectors, broken tabs, moisture/corrosion and option labels
stages.stop_when: unsafe brake/restraint condition for driving; unrepairable missing safety equipment
stages.hold_when: unknown SRS history, incomplete recall evidence, missing scarce parts without lawful deliverable source; no SRS bypass

stages.title: Evidence-led feasibility and disposition
capture: itemize confirmed essential repair, suspected fault and unknown diagnosis separately
obtain exact part/condition/warranty/delivery and programming/tool/shop/towing/title/inspection quotes
owner budget ceiling and explicit acceptance of any major assembly work; unknown costs never zero
stages.stop_when: all earlier STOP conditions override; confirmed work beyond repair objective
stages.hold_when: any unresolved identity, structure, engine/gearbox/safety fault, rare-part supply or total essential-cost blocker

public_repository_rule: Keep full VIN, titles, faces, seller identity/messages/address and private photographs out of this public repository.
